programme.title: Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc: Ob Abfahrt oder Super-G, Slalom oder Riesenslalom: Das Programm im alpinen Ski-Weltcup ist vielfältig. Los geht es am 24. Oktober 2026 in Sölden mit dem Riesenslalom der Frauen. Einen Tag später starten dort auch die Männer in ihre Weltcup-Saison. Das Saisonhighlight bilden die Alpinen Ski-Weltmeisterschaften 2027 im schweizerischen Crans-Montana.

programme.title: Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc:
Vor einem Jahr erlebte Levi den ersten brasilianischen Weltcup-Sieger im Ski alpin: Lucas Pinheiro Braathen fuhr erstmals seit seinem Nationenwechsel ganz nach oben aufs Podest.

Die Gastgeber durften sich derweil über einen dritten Platz des jungen Finnen Eduard Hallberg freuen. Das Podium komplettierte der Franzose Clément Noël.

Enttäuschend endete der Saisonauftakt in Levi damals für die Schweizer, die allesamt die Top Ten verpassten, und für Linus Straßer: Der Münchner fiel von Platz vier noch auf Rang 15 zurück.

Ob es diesmal besser gelaufen ist? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skispringen: Weltcup
programme.desc:
Die neue Weltcup-Saison steht an. Vom 20. November 2026 bis zum 21. März 2027 heben die Skispringer und Skispringerinnen wieder von den Schanzen ab. Der Weltcup-Auftakt steigt im norwegischen Lillehammer. Nach aktuellem FIS-Kalender endet die Saison mit dem Weltcup-Finale in Planica. 

Eines der großen Highlights bildet wie jedes Jahr die Vierschanzentournee rund um den Jahreswechsel. Die 75. Ausgabe ist eine historische: Erstmals tragen auch die Frauen eine vollständige Vierschanzentournee auf allen vier Schanzen aus. Die Tournee führt vom 29. Dezember 2026 bis zum 6. Januar 2027 über Oberstdorf, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Innsbruck und Bischofshofen. Bereits am 28. Dezember stehen in Oberstdorf die ersten Wettbewerbe beziehungsweise Qualifikationen auf dem Programm. Die traditionsreiche Tournee wurde erstmals 1953 ausgetragen. 

Ein weiteres Saisonhighlight sind die Nordischen Ski-Weltmeisterschaften 2027 im schwedischen Falun. Die Weltmeisterschaften finden vom 24. Februar bis zum 7. März 2027 statt; die Skisprung-Wettbewerbe sind im aktuellen FIS-Kalender vom 25. Februar bis zum 7. März angesetzt. Falun war bereits mehrfach Austragungsort einer Nordischen Ski-WM, zuletzt 2015.

programme.title: Skispringen: Weltcup
programme.desc: Beim Sommer-Grand-Prix-Finale in Klingenthal vor vier Wochen zeichnete sich ab, dass die Norweger gut auf den Winter vorbereitet sind. Sie gewannen mit deutlichem Vorsprung vor Slowenien und Japan. Das DSV-Quartett wurde Fünfter.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de esquí alpino F - Levi
programme.desc: La segunda parada de la Copa del mundo de esquí alpino se disputa en Finlandia. La estación de Levi Black acoge competición de eslalon. Paula Moltzan conquistó el gigante inaugural. Mikaela Shiffrin es la histórica dominadora de esta cita en el Círculo Polar Ártico.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series _ Resumen
programme.desc: Una serie de carreras de montaña de alto nivel que reúnen a los mejores corredores de trail running del mundo. El certamen ofrece desafíos atléticos y escenarios impresionantes en diferentes lugares del planeta.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de esquí alpino M - Levi
programme.desc: La de Levi es la segunda prueba oficial de la temporada en el calendario de la Copa del mundo y representa la primera carrera de la campaña en la disciplina de eslalon. Se disputa en la pista Levi Black, un trazado muy técnico situado en el Círculo Polar Ártico.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de saltos de esquí M - Lillehammer
programme.desc: El histórico trampolín de Lysgardsbakken vuelve a ser el gran escenario de apertura de la temporada invernal en la Copa del mundo de saltos de esquí. Del 20 al 22 de noviembre, los mejores especialistas pretenden empezar con buen pie en la cita noruega.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de saltos de esquí M - Garmisch Partenkirchen
programme.desc: La de Bischofshofen es la undécima prueba de la temporada y la cuarta del prestigioso Torneo de los Cuatro Trampolines. Los mejores saltadores de esquí del mundo participan en este certamen que premia la regularidad. Daniel Tschofenig defiende título.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de saltos de esquí por equipos - Lillehammer

programme.title: Snooker: WM
programme.desc: Der Snooker-Weltverband WPBSA richtet jedes Jahr die Snookerweltmeisterschaft aus. Die erste Ausgabe fand 1927 statt. Das Turnier gilt als das bedeutendste Snookerereignis weltweit und markiert zugleich den Abschluss der Main-Tour-Saison. Seit den Anfängen wird der Sport stark von britischen Spielern dominiert und die meisten Weltmeister stammen aus dem Vereinigten Königreich. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc:
Vor einem Jahr erlebte Levi den ersten brasilianischen Weltcup-Sieger im Ski alpin: Lucas Pinheiro Braathen fuhr erstmals seit seinem Nationenwechsel ganz nach oben aufs Podest.

Die Gastgeber durften sich derweil über einen dritten Platz des jungen Finnen Eduard Hallberg freuen. Das Podium komplettierte der Franzose Clément Noël.

Enttäuschend endete der Saisonauftakt in Levi damals für die Schweizer, die allesamt die Top Ten verpassten, und für Linus Straßer: Der Münchner fiel von Platz vier noch auf Rang 15 zurück.

Ob es diesmal besser gelaufen ist? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skispringen: Weltcup
programme.desc:
Die neue Weltcup-Saison steht an. Vom 20. November 2026 bis zum 21. März 2027 heben die Skispringer und Skispringerinnen wieder von den Schanzen ab. Der Weltcup-Auftakt steigt im norwegischen Lillehammer. Nach aktuellem FIS-Kalender endet die Saison mit dem Weltcup-Finale in Planica. 

Eines der großen Highlights bildet wie jedes Jahr die Vierschanzentournee rund um den Jahreswechsel. Die 75. Ausgabe ist eine historische: Erstmals tragen auch die Frauen eine vollständige Vierschanzentournee auf allen vier Schanzen aus. Die Tournee führt vom 29. Dezember 2026 bis zum 6. Januar 2027 über Oberstdorf, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Innsbruck und Bischofshofen. Bereits am 28. Dezember stehen in Oberstdorf die ersten Wettbewerbe beziehungsweise Qualifikationen auf dem Programm. Die traditionsreiche Tournee wurde erstmals 1953 ausgetragen. 

Ein weiteres Saisonhighlight sind die Nordischen Ski-Weltmeisterschaften 2027 im schwedischen Falun. Die Weltmeisterschaften finden vom 24. Februar bis zum 7. März 2027 statt; die Skisprung-Wettbewerbe sind im aktuellen FIS-Kalender vom 25. Februar bis zum 7. März angesetzt. Falun war bereits mehrfach Austragungsort einer Nordischen Ski-WM, zuletzt 2015.

programme.title: Springreiten: Weltcup
programme.desc: Um 27 Hundertstel verpassten Rene Dittmer und Cody im vergangenen Jahr das Stechen in Toronto. Damit landete das Paar auf einem guten vierten Rang. Den Sieg holte sich am Ende Conor Swail mit Casturano. Mit 54 Jahren war der Ire 33 Jahre älter als die beiden US-Amerikanerinnen Skylar Wireman und Mimi Gochman, die hinter ihm aufs Podest kamen. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: El Mundial, el torneo profesional más importante en términos de puntos y de ranking, pone el colofón a la temporada de snooker. Desde 1977, se celebra en el Crucible Theatre de la localidad inglesa de Sheffield. En 2025, el vencedor fue el chino Zhao Xintong.

programme.title: Aída
programme.sub-title: Charli y la fábrica de prostitutas
programme.desc: El rechazo con el que Paz ha respondido hasta ahora a los intentos de Luisma para mantener una relación con ella no ha conseguido que el joven baje la guardia. Pero los planes de boda de la amiga de Aída con Charly, un antiguo novio que la incitó a dedicarse al mundo de la prostitución, provocarán que el ánimo de Luisma se desmorone. Por otra parte, el esfuerzo que está realizando Chema para que su hijo Fidel pueda cumplir el deseo de ir a Londres a estudiar le lleva a la extenuación. Además de regentar la tienda, el tendero sigue enrolándose en diversos trabajos con el fin de aumentar sus ingresos. Sin conocer el sacrificio que está llevando a cabo su padre, Fidel se muestra constantemente exigente con él.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un culebrón interracial, una detención ilegal y el palacete del conde Manfredum
programme.desc: Fermín y Vicente se dan el 'sí, quiero' en el desenlace de la décima temporada. Un palacete del siglo XVIII es el escenario de esta peculiar boda de la que todos sus vecinos son testigo. Pero la larga lista de espera del lugar obliga a los contrayentes a idear un plan. Mientras, Yoli y Menchu se obsesionan con finalizar los últimos ajustes de sus estilismos para las nupcias y acaban inmersas en un grave contratiempo familiar. Por su parte, Enrique mantiene un tenso enfrentamiento con Antonio ante la negativa del pescatero a devolverle el dinero que le prestó. Para solucionar el conflicto problema, Alba está dispuesta a devolver a su novio la cantidad adeudada por su padre. Pero la convivencia en casa de los Recio se complica más por la presencia de sus respectivas parejas de forma permanente. Además, los hijos de los Cuquis denuncian a Amador y Maite para que la justicia les retire su custodia.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un mayorista filántropo, un putero soviético y un agradecido desgraciado
programme.desc: Antonio recibe la temida notificación de lanzamiento: debe abandonar la pescadería. Amador y Fermín descubren que Óscar y Victoria venden sus pisos. Julia monta una web para subastar su virginidad. Greta y Esteban pujarán para evitar que su hija mancille su honor. Yoli y Óscar planifican su boda. El pique de suegras está servido. Maite intenta dejar a Alonso.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un bodorrio tóxico, un burbujón inmobiliario y un secuestro exprés
programme.desc: Noelia ha despertado del coma. Antonio y Berta apremian a Cristina y Martín para que les paguen el bajo. Amador y Fermín fingen un secuestro. Yoli, que está ilusionadísima por su boda con Oscar y más por ser madrastra. Greta, obsesionada por evitar que un extraño desvirgue a su hija, puja con todo lo que tiene, pero un rival se lo pondrá difícil. Maite disfruta de su nueva relación con Alonso.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: APEC Selfies: An Australian entrepreneur is taking AI beyond the screen. What's next
programme.desc: From interactive smart bins to public installations that respond to emotions, Australian product designer and Sencity co-founder Steven Bai is exploring how AI can be integrated into streets, buildings and public spaces - taking technology beyond screens and into everyday life.From conceiving his startup idea to putting down roots in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, he is drawing on China's well-developed manufacturing ecosystem to bring Physical AI innovations to global markets. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear.

programme.title: China through the eyes of CanCham Chair
programme.desc: For Dr. Mark Ceolin, Shanghai is more than a gateway to China and the Asia-Pacific - it is where his personal journey and China-Canada connections took root. Having witnessed the city’s remarkable rise since the 2000s, he has dedicated himself to helping Canadian companies grow in China. Seeing is believing. Today, Mark guides a growing number of Canadian businesses to experience a welcoming market full of emerging possibilities.

programme.title: APEC Selfies: Why this ROK entrepreneur wants to call China's shoe capital home
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Michael Lee from ‪the Republic of Korea‬ came to China in 2003. More than two decades later, he now calls Quanzhou in Fujian Province his home. In Jinjiang, a county-level city under Quanzhou and one of China's leading footwear manufacturing hubs, he found a world-class supply chain, constant innovation, and the opportunity to build his own business.His next big plan? To become a true local! #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Why are global entrepreneurs choosing Shenzhen
programme.desc: What makes Shenzhen such an attractive place to launch a business? With the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaching, all eyes are on this innovation-driven city in China. But beyond its reputation as a tech hub, what does it actually take to turn a big idea into a real product here? In this episode of #BizPodcast, CGTN talks with two entrepreneurs about why they chose Shenzhen, how they bring ideas to market, and what young founders should know before starting a business. Would you consider starting a business in Shenzhen? What would you want to know first.

programme.title: Shared Future for Asia Pacific: Best-selling hair dryer highlights strengths of southern China's cross-border supply chain
programme.desc: As China hosts APEC 2026, regional integration is taking center stage. In southern China's Greater Bay Area, cities like Zhuhai, Hengqin, and Macao are operating like a single supply chain network, linking automated factories with global talent and capital. To see how this cross-border teamwork helps brands go global, CGTN's Yu Hongyu takes us inside a hair dryer factory in Zhuhai.

programme.title: Shenzhen empowers Asia-Pacific with new quality productive forces
programme.desc: Once a fishing town, Shenzhen is now a city where emerging technologies move quickly from concept to daily life. Our reporter Wang Tianyu explores what powers that transformation. Take a look.

programme.title: Behind every screen: Shenzhen lights up the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: From the phone in your pocket to the giant screens lighting up city skylines, a huge share of the world's displays trace back to one place: China's Greater Bay Area, specifically Shenzhen. Panels and LED modules... the whole chain sits within a few hours' drive, and that's what lets companies scale fast. Our reporter Wang Tianyu went inside the industry to find out how Shenzhen is putting that edge to work for customers worldwide.

programme.title: From bikes to your phone: Carbon fiber weaves the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Carbon fiber-once reserved for aerospace and elite racing-is now powering a much broader industrial shift across the Asia-Pacific. In southern China, Guangdong province is turning lower-cost mass production into a major export advantage. CGTN's Yu Hongyu explores how this featherlight thread is is driving billions in APEC trade.

programme.title: OFFSHORE WIND Powers the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: You flip a switch, and the lights come on. But where does that power come from? In Yangjiang, Guangdong, the answer lies offshore. The city leads all of China's prefecture-level cities in offshore wind capacity, backed by a growing industrial chain spanning turbine manufacturing, testing and operations. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun takes you inside China's offshore wind industry and explores how it is helping power the Asia-Pacific's green transition.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token EconomyDemand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style's fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey..

programme.title: PODCAST: Finding peace in a bustling tourist town - the timeless allure of Dali
programme.desc: Dali is a magical place, nestled between towering peaks and a shimmering lake, just shy of 2,000m altitude in southwest China's culturally diverse Yunnan province. While filming here, Travelogue hosts Alex McCutcheon, Tianran He and Jack Klumpp unpack how this area, once a powerful kingdom and crucial trading hub, has transformed into a hub of tourism, catering to millions in search of a slower pace of life. They toy with the idea of joining Dali's growing population of "urban refugees.

programme.title: Aerial China IV: Guangxi
programme.desc: With the beautiful Beibu Gulf to the south, crisscrossed with the waterways of the Xijiang River system, South China’s Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region truly in a natural wonder to behold. programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1

From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN's integrated media cultural and travel program "China Untapped: Suzhou" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou's high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou's urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan,..

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: PODCAST: When influencer culture meets ancient lakeside town - the changing face of Dali
programme.desc: Filming at a lakeside village in China's picturesque Dali prefecture, Travelogue hosts Tianran He, Jack Klumpp and Alex McCutcheon find themselves at an establishment that is two parts coffee house, eight parts photography studio, swarming with professional photographers and dedicated influencers all striving for that perfect cover photo against the shimmering Erhai Lake. They reflect on the almost mystical allure that has led travelers, past and present, to fall in love with Dali and never want to leave. Over an elegantly served Americano, they discuss how coffee production, redevelopment, and modern tourism trends are reshaping this idyllic corner of the world.

programme.title: Aerial China IV: Henan
programme.desc: Perhaps there’s no place that epitomises the cultural grandeur of China’s central plains than Henan. A cradle of Chinese civilization, abounding with resources and talented people, this is a place that has thousands of years of history in every corner. And what better opportunity to get the lowdown from on high on the cultural jewel that is Henan than by joining us on Aerial China IV.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.desc: Lahjakkaan laulaja-lauluntekijän sydän särkyy, kun kuuluisa muusikkopoikaystävä jättää hänet juuri ennen joulua. Hän palaa kotikaupunkiinsa löytääkseen uudelleen musiikin, romantiikan, perheen ja joulun taian.

programme.title: Kuuhullut (Moonstruck)
programme.desc: Tässä klassisessa romanttisessa komediassa Brooklynin leski (Cher) on valmis menemään uudelleen naimisiin. Tällä kertaa hän aikoo tehdä sen oikein, vaikka joutuisikin sanomaan ”kyllä” miehelle, jota hän ei oikeasti rakasta.

programme.title: Perheellä on Väliä Joulu
programme.desc: Joulu on kaikkea muuta kuin tavallinen, kun kolme sisarusta uudesta uusperheestä - eivät ole samaa mieltä. Taikuuden avulla he vaihtavat kehoja eivätkä voi muuttua takaisin - ennen kuin oppivat viettämään joulun rakastavana perheenä.

programme.title: Lähetys joulua
programme.desc: Kun hänen lähetyskumppaninsa päättää lähteä Amerikan suosikkiaamuohjelmasta, Veronika Daniels ilmoittaa valitsevansa uuden juontajakansa kourallisen ehdokkaiden joukosta, joihin kuuluu paikallinen New Yorkin uutislähettäjä Charlie Fisher.

programme.title: 12 Joulukoiraa
programme.desc: Leski-isä lähettää tyttärensä tätinsä luo kaupunkiin, joka on kieltänyt koirat. Kun hän päättää pitää kulkukoiran, hän haluaa auttaa koiria - ja hurmata pormestarin ikimuistoisimmalla joulunäytelmällä.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Cooperien iso perhe kokoontuu viettämään joulua yhdessä, mutta perinteisiä kuvioita sotkevat yllätysvieraat.

programme.title: What Just Happened
programme.desc: Viikko Hollywood-tuottajan Benin elämässä. Ben neuvottelee studiojohtajan kanssa, jotta hänen uusin elokuvansa saisi ensi-iltansa Cannesissa kahden viikon kuluttua. Hän on hermostunut ohjaaja, jonka on tehtävä editointi elokuvaan.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Josh ja Cornelia ovat onnellisesti naimisissa. Perheen perustaminen jäi heiltä onnistumatta, mutta se ei heitä vaivaa. Tuskaillessaan uuden dokumenttielokuvansa valmistumisen parissa Joshista alkaa kuitenkin tuntua, että elämästä puuttuu jotain.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Rakkaustarina feminiinisyydestä, maskuliinisuudesta ja 68 000 dollarin varkaudesta. Chip on simppeli kaveri ja upea tyttöystävä nimeltä Liza. Liza tosin hankkii heidän elantonsa namusedältään, mutta toisaalta jokaisessa parisuhteessa on omat erikoisuutensa.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business.

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling.

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Acqua da proteggere
programme.desc: With Marco Faimali, director of the CNR's Institute for the Study of Marine Sustainability, we explore the ocean's fragile ecosystem and the need for protection. Anna Pancaldi visits marine protected areas, including the Smart Bay of Santa Teresa and the port of La Spezia, where researchers study "alien species". Finally, we learn about the underwater internet, an innovation from Sapienza University of Rome led by Professor Chiara Petrioli and the WSENSE team.

programme.title: Whats On - 19 - Carnival Across the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Step into a world of color, music, and masks as the Mediterranean celebrates its iconic carnivals. Malta Karnival lights up the streets with parades and flamboyant costumes. In Slovenia, the Carnival in Cerknica keeps centuries old traditions alive, and Italy legendary Venice Carnival mesmerizes with elegance and historic pageantry. This is celebration at its most spectacular.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: In Milan we'll take a peek at Italy's highest fashion, fanciest delis, grandest cemetery, and greatest opera house...not to mention Leonardo's "Last Supper." Then we'll cruise Lake Como, settling down in the lakeside village of Varenna.

programme.title: Malini Egypt
programme.desc: Malini Angelica visits Egypt for the first time, exploring Cairo and the Pyramids of Giza. Beyond the headlines and common tourist warnings, she discovers unexpected warmth, culture, and a different side to these iconic places.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus.

programme.title: Med Destinations Lake Bled
programme.desc: Step into the fairytale beauty of Lake Bled, Slovenia, on Med Destinations. Crystal-clear waters, a picturesque island church, and lush Alpine surroundings make it a serene Mediterranean escape.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Athens
programme.desc: Malini explores the ancient city of Athens, Greece. Once steeped in history, Athens has experienced a modern rebirth, now thriving with creativity, modern Greek gastronomy, a vibrant contemporary art scene, and unmatched nightlife.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini

programme.title: Made in Med: Tradition of Glassmaking
programme.sub-title: S01:E05 Made in Med: Tradition of Glassmaking
programme.desc: On the island of Gozo, Fadi steps into the world of Daniel and Gozo Glass, where more than 35 years of glassmaking tradition continue to burn brightly. Working with intense heat, vibrant colours, and molten glass, Daniel reveals what it takes to turn a passion into a way of life. From learning to handle the heat to developing the patience needed to master every detail, discover the dedication behind creating and perfecting a dream design.

programme.title: Med Destinations Ancona
programme.desc: Explore Ancona, a bustling port city on the Adriatic, with Med Destinations. Discover its historic landmarks, scenic waterfronts, and the unique blend of maritime tradition and modern Italian life.

programme.title: The tapestries of the Grand Master Restoration
programme.desc: Towards the end of summer 1710, a precious cargo was unloaded on the shores of the Grand Harbour. Whoever opened that merchandise and laid eyes on it for the first time must surely have been astonished by its beauty. The tapestries of the Grand Master’s Palace had arrived in Malta. Watch their 300-year-old story unfold in this documentary by Heritage Malta.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Calm Your Body
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Med Destinations Delos
programme.desc: Step into the myth and mystery of Delos with Med Destinations. This tiny island, rich in archaeological wonders and legendary tales, offers a unique glimpse into Greece’s ancient past amid stunning coastal vistas.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena
programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: The spotlight falls on two traditional Cypriot favorites. First, we explore the art of preparing Oven Lamb Kleftiko, a slow-cooked dish where tender lamb is infused with herbs and baked to perfection, capturing the essence of village cooking. Then, the journey continues with Kattimeria, fried sweet flatbreads that balance crisp texture with a hint of indulgent sweetness. Together, these recipes showcase the comforting richness and variety of Cyprus’s culinary heritage.

programme.title: Med Nations 05 Morocco
programme.desc: Morocco! The bridge between Africa and the Mediterranean. Morocco's lively markets, delicious foods, and long-standing traditions show how trade, travellers, and different cultures have shaped the country over the years.

programme.title: Med Minds 10 Julius Caesar
programme.desc: Julius Caesar, the formidable leader of ancient Rome, became a lasting symbol of ambition, power, and transformation, shaping the destiny of the Mediterranean world through conquest, vision, and a legacy that endures beyond his dramatic fall.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.sub-title: S06:E03 Dubrovnik and Balkan Side Trips
programme.desc: Exploring Croatia, Montenegro, and Bosnia, we’ll get to know the three major groups of the former Yugoslavia, Croats, Serbs, and Bosniaks, before enjoying a bit of fun in the sun along the Adriatic in Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Marseille
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Marseille, France’s vibrant Mediterranean port city. She explores its historic Old Port, colorful neighborhoods, and bustling markets, discovering the city’s unique blend of French and North African influences. From sampling local dishes like bouillabaisse to soaking in seaside views and street art, Malini uncovers what makes Marseille one of France’s most dynamic and diverse cities.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: For four years, a dedicated team of filmmakers, scientists, and experts explored the Mediterraneo, capturing breathtaking moments where nature and humanity collide. This powerful documentary reveals stunning images of the sea’s beauty and the urgent struggle to protect it, offering a moving portrait of our relationship with nature.

programme.title: Dates that made History
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 399 BC The Trial Of Socrates
programme.desc: 399 BC: The Trial of Socrates dramatises the famous trial of the Greek philosopher Socrates, who is charged with corrupting the youth and impiety. The episode delves into Socrates' defence, his philosophical ideas, and his unwavering commitment to his principles. It explores the tension between individual thought and the societal norms of ancient Athens. Through this trial, the show examines the impact of Socrates' ideas on Western philosophy and his legacy.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Release Stress from the Body

programme.title: The Great Greek Myths

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: El rascacielos
programme.desc: Un experto en seguridad tratará de infiltrarse en un rascacielos en llamas, el más alto del mundo con 225 pisos, donde su familia se encuentra atrapada junto a un grupo de criminales. Después de trabajar con el popular actor y luchador Dwayne Johnson en 'Un espía y medio', el realizador Rawson Marshall Thurber vuelve a confiar en el forzudo intérprete para este adrenalítico thriller de acción no apto para personas con vértigo o miedo a las alturas. La Roca encarna aquí al antiguo jefe de un equipo de rescate de rehenes del FBI que debe volver a hacer gala de sus habilidades para rescatar a sus seres queridos de un gigantesco edificio, que ha comenzado a arder tras ser saboteado. A modo de curiosidad, muchos verán ciertas similitudes con un título considerado como clásico dentro del género: 'La Jungla de Cristal'. De hecho, una de las imágenes promocionales no se cortó al imitar el póster de la célebre cinta estrenada en 1988 con Bruce Willis como protagonista.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: En la Inglaterra del siglo XIII el arquero Robin Longstride lucha en las Cruzadas al servicio del Rey. Cuando el monarca fallece, Robin se traslada a Nottingham para cumplir una promesa: llevar una espada a Sir Walter Loxley. Será entonces cuando conocerá a Lady Marion.Una especie de precuela de la leyenda de Robin Hood dirigida por Ridley Scott con un presupuesto descomunal de más de 140 millones de euros. El director de ''Blade Runner'' vuelve a confiar en uno de sus actores fetiche, Russell Crowe, que fue escogido dejando de lado otras opciones como Christian Bale o Sam Riley. La cinta bebe claramente de las influencias de la aclamada ''Gladiator'', no solo en cuanto al equipo sino también a nivel de realización y estructura argumental.Scott, que admitió no ser nada apasionado de la leyenda, presionó para modificar substancialmente el guion original. El primer borrador, titulado ''Nottingham'', presentaba a Robin Hood como villano y al Sheriff como un personaje más humanizado. El realizador insistió en acercar el libreto a la versión tradicional de la historia, por lo que el título también fue modificado.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Colter se dirige a Willow Creek, Michigan, después de que una madre preocupada le contrate para localizar a su hija Riley, reina de la belleza, que desapareció mientras volvía a casa del trabajo. Mientras investiga en el centro de jardinería donde trabaja Riley, Colter indaga en su pasado como modelo y descubre que ocultaba un gran secreto.

programme.title: Tracker

programme.desc: Tout part d'un concours. Rien à voir avec ceux que Boris avait passés pour intégrer Centrale. Là tout compte, la chance, les appuis, les tendances, les combats, toutes choses auxquelles le jeune homme n'est pas préparé et qu'il refuse même d'admettre.

programme.title: George et Fanchette - Première partie
programme.desc: A Nohant, durant l'été 1846. George Sand recrute Fanchette, une jeune "pastoure.

programme.title: Le bruit des trousseaux
programme.desc: Alexis Pasquier, un jeune enseignant français, débute son premier jour de travail au centre de détention de Nancy, où il rencontre une jeune femme dont il tombe brutalement amoureux. C'est dans la naissance de cet amour que le jeune homme découvre l'univers carcéral.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.sub-title: S15:E11 La honte de la famille
programme.desc: Une banque privée est cambriolée et une des employées est abattue. Dans la poursuite qui s'en suit, Sami et Ben causent quelques ennuis à un ministre en pleine campagne électorale.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Sami et Ben doivent former des jeunes recrues. L'un d'entre eux, abattu en cours de formation, leur livre un message sibyllin avant de mourir. Ils vont donc se mettre sur la piste du meurtrier, un ponte de la drogue qui se ferait appeler le Bonhomme de neige.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Le secrétaire d'Etat chargé des transports vient présenter la nouvelle voiture écologique à la police. Il souhaite qu'un essai soit réalisé, et confie à Sami le soin de patrouiller avec le prototype.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.sub-title: S15:E14 Une nuit pas si douce
programme.desc: Ben et Sami sont de service la nuit du réveillon de Noël. C'est alors qu'ils tombent sur un homme qui cause d'importants accidents sur l'autoroute. Dans sa course folle, il a également endommagé un fourgon de transport de prisonniers.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Rolf Lehmann, homme d'affaires, est très scrupuleux. Il possède de nombreux sites, dont un géré par Monika Wagner. Voulant détruire l'endroit pour y construire un grand centre commercial, il va devoir utiliser de bien vilaines méthodes.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Tom, qui a un jour de congé, sort avec Petra, une ancienne collègue. Les pauvres se font prendre dans un hold-up sur la route et Petra se fait tuer.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Le tueur Dedic pourchasse Peter Schmidt et son fils Robert, jusqu'à ce qu'il sorte de la route. Peter survit à cet accident gravement blessé alors que son fils en sort presque indemne. Mais le tueur n'en reste pas là.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils effectuent un contrôle de routine sur l'autoroute, Tom et Semir prennent en chasse un camion qui roule à très vive allure. Ils tentent d'arrêter le conducteur imprudent mais l'accident est inévitable. Le chauffeur perd le contrôle du véhicule et entre en collision avec un autre camion.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Semir n'est pas encore arrivé au bureau et Tom se voit donc contraint de poursuivre, seul, une voiture qui roule à vive allure sur l'autoroute. Les deux véhicules entrent en collision. Tom quitte la route et se retrouve dans un champ tandis que l'autre conducteur percute un panneau de signalisation.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Un camion-citerne contenant une cargaison d'armes illicites est intercepté par Tom et Semir sur une autoroute. Lea Van Kerkhoven, la millionnaire commanditaire de l'opération, décide de faire disparaître Tom et Semir.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Tom et Semir enquêtent sur le trafiquant d'armes ayant utilisé le camion-citerne. Mais ils ignorent que celui-ci cherche à se débarasser d'eux. Ils sont attaqués par un inconnu et perdent tous deux connaissance.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Un fourgon transportant des oeuvres d'art se voit contraint de quitter l'autoroute. Tom et Semir se rendent aussitôt sur les lieux de l'accident tout comme Anna Engelhardt, qui est aussi sur le chemin.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Adam Vladek fait du chantage à Ernst Wagner, un agent immobilier. Il a en sa possession des images qui prouvent de façon certaine que Ernst est un tueur. Adam rencontre Johannes, le fils de Ernst, pour procéder à l'échange des photos contre de l'argent.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Maria Struck, une chanteuse d'opéra aveugle, est kidnappée par Harry et Frank, deux frères gangsters. La victime est cachée dans les bois. Elle tente, par tous les moyens, de s'échapper. Elle parvient à se libérer et court, désorientée, vers une autoroute sur laquelle elle cause un accident.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Le jour de Noël, Mingzhe fait sa demande sur un panneau d'affichage géant. Les deux couples se marient lors d'une cérémonie de conte de fées, trouvant enfin l'âme sœur.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Bloquée à Londres après une trahison familiale, Xia Ranran rencontre Shao Mingzhe, PDG d'une entreprise technologique. Ils concluent un pacte : il lui donne des cours pour préparer l'université, elle tient la maison.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Ranran est admise à l'université et tombe amoureuse de Mingzhe. Pendant ce temps, son ex-petite amie Su Mo découvre qu'ils vivent sous le même toit.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Un incendie se déclare dans leur immeuble. Ranran se précipite pour sauver Mingzhe et se blesse. Leur lien se renforce à travers ce sauvetage traumatisant.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Ranran découvre les insomnies de Mingzhe et un traumatisme d'enfance lié à une poupée effrayante. Elle commence à percer l'homme qui se cache derrière son apparence froide.

programme.title: Juste pour te revoir
programme.desc: Mingzhe aide Ranran à améliorer son anglais. Leurs chamailleries quotidiennes se muent peu à peu en respect mutuel et en attirance non avouée.

programme.title: Rien que trente
programme.desc: Gu Jia avance seule. Manni s'attache trop à Liang. Xiaoqin s'effondre après une rencontre inattendue avec Chen Yu.

programme.title: Rien que trente
programme.desc: Gu Jia s'inquiète davantage. Manni dépend trop de Liang. Xiaoqin et Chen Yu retrouvent leurs sentiments, reconstruire la confiance.

programme.title: Rien que trente
programme.desc: Gu Jia prépare un accord de divorce, sécurisant ses droits et son fils. Manni envisage de quitter le pays.

programme.title: Rien que trente
programme.desc: Gu Jia planifie à long terme, devient décisive. Manni envisage une nouvelle voie à l'étranger.

programme.title: La Guerre des Belles-mères
programme.desc: He Lin peine face à la vie rurale. Sa belle-mère Wang Meichang lui offre 200 yuans. Cette nuit-là, Hongxia les pousse dans la même chambre; ils couchent ensemble.

programme.title: La Guerre des Belles-mères
programme.desc: Wang Meichang accepte He Lin et prépare le mariage. Le père de He Lin offre une maison en dot. Chuanzhi réussit le concours de la fonction publique, fierté familiale.

programme.title: La Guerre des Belles-mères
programme.desc: Au mariage, la belle-mère offre à He Lin une bague en or dans un tissu rouge. Après les noces, les parents ruraux de Chuanzhi débarquent un par un, bouleversant sa vie.

programme.title: La Guerre des Belles-mères
programme.desc: La belle-mère adore la maison, annule l'hôtel, s'installe avec Hongxia. La tante de He Lin pousse Chuanzhi à signer une reconnaissance de dette. Il cède, furieux. L'orage gronde.

programme.title: La Guerre des Belles-mères
programme.desc: La belle-mère règne en impératrice. Xiuhua attend une fille – elle est mécontente. La tante de He Lin ment : He Lin serait enceinte, pour sécuriser la maison.
