programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Straw Dogs
programme.desc: In a rural town, a young couple (James Marsden and Kate Bosworth) fights for survival when they re marked for death by depraved locals led by a ruthless predator (Alexander Skarsgård).

programme.title: Suspect
programme.desc: A public defender pokes into places she shouldn't while trying to exonerate an innocent man accused of murder. Edited for TV.

programme.title: Agnes Of God
programme.desc: An analyst is sent to a convent to investigate the case of a young nun whose newborn baby is found strangled.

programme.title: Raising Waylon
programme.desc: Reg and Julia, unconventional godparents to a nine-year old boy named Waylon are blindsided when his parents die and they are left to care for the boy.

programme.title: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
programme.desc: Following their grandfather to Japan, the three underage ninjas find themselves in the middle of martial arts mayhem. Pursued by a bumbling trio of brain-dead thieves and an army of well-trained ninjas, Rocky, Colt, and Tum Tum are up to their ears in high-kicking action and rapid-fire comedy.

programme.title: North
programme.desc: Sick of the neglect he receives from his mom and dad, a young boy leaves home and travels the world in search of new parents.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers Andy and Mark learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island, but vanished without a trace…taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family – if they can find it in time. Sinister forces also search for the money and will stop at nothing to keep the boys from their quest. As the adventure unfolds, the boys learn that the bonds of family are the most valuable riches of all, and that some family secrets can t stay buried forever.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Boog, a grizzly bear with no survival skills, has his perfect world turned upside-down when he meets Elliot, a scrawny, fast-talking wild mule deer. When Elliot convinces Boog to desert his idyllic existence living in a garage decked out with all the comforts of home, and try the "wild" life, things quickly spiral out of control. With open season upon them, Elliot must help Boog get in touch with his inner grizzly to unite the woodland creatures and take the forest back!

programme.title: It Happened To Jane
programme.desc: A Maine widow becomes a cause celebre when she sues a railroad tycoon over the loss of a valuable shipment of lobsters.

programme.title: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: An aging New England Mayor is defeated in a hard-fought re-election campaign involving shady transactions by both political groups.

programme.title: To Sir, With Love
programme.desc: An unemployed engineer takes a job as a teacher of hostile and rebellious students in their last year at a high school in London's tough East End.

programme.title: Five Easy Pieces
programme.desc: Nicholson plays the now iconic cad Bobby Dupea, a shiftless thirtysomething oil rigger and former piano prodigy immune to any sense of responsibility, who returns to his upper-middle-class childhood home, blue-collar girlfriend (Nashville’s Karen Black, in an Oscar-nominated role) in tow, to see his estranged ailing father.

programme.title: In Cold Blood
programme.desc: IN COLD BLOOD dramatizes actual events and people in a realistic, technically well-crafted fashion, based upon Truman Capote s novel. The movie is a faithful docudrama about the real-life mass murder of the Clutter family, which took place in Holcomb, Kansas on November 15, 1959 by two psychopathic killers.

programme.title: Oliver!
programme.desc: Charles Dickens classic tale of a waif in 19th Century England comes alive brilliantly in this Oscar-winning musical. Fleeing a life of workhouse servitude, Oliver (Mark Lester) arrives in London to seek his fortune. During his adventures, Oliver meets a gallery of unforgettable Dickens low-lifes.

programme.title: Three Hours To Kill
programme.desc: A wrongly accused cowboy saved from hanging is set free to hunt the real killer of his fiancee.

programme.title: Daring Danger
programme.desc: Tim McCoy is nearly killed in a fight with Alexander. He recovers and goes after the bad man, catching up to him and finding that he has taken up with a rustler. Of course, McCoy now has to go after the rustler, too. The film is based on a story by William Colt MacDonald.

programme.title: The Quick Gun
programme.desc: A gunslinger helps an ungrateful town fight off a raid by his former gang.

programme.title: Gunmen From Laredo
programme.desc: A jailed rancher escapes to track down the outlaws who framed him for a murder he didn't commit.

programme.title: Mackenna's Gold
programme.desc: A US Marshal is forced to lead a gang of bandits to a hidden valley of gold.

programme.title: Blazing Across The Pecos
programme.desc: A gambler decides he wants to build a private empire out of the pecos flat bribes and bribes a bandof Indians to terrorize people and raid the wagon trains. The Durango Kid intervenes and rescues the ransom money.

programme.title: Avenging Waters
programme.desc: A ranch hand helps out a family battling a rival rancher over water rights, but finds him trapped when a dam breaks, threatening a flood.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: A powerful rancher always protects his wild adult son with hush money, until the son's crimes cross the line.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

Gabriel Jaime Marulanda, el agresor identificado, fue capturado en 2015 y condenado a 46 años por homicidio agravado y 9 años más por actos sexuales con menor de edad.

programme.title: El Rastro

Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel y Baltasar se ponen a los mandos de un Robotín gigante para obligar al rey Gerard a que les entregue a Pitufo Robotín. Cuando el Robotín está a punto de destruir el castillo, Gigantón, el nuevo, enorme y extraño amigo de Pitufo Robotín, vence al Robotín. Pitufo Robotín sufre daños durante la batalla, pero Pitufo Carpintero lo arregla y le implanta una caja de voz que le permite decir «¡Hola!».

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata….

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Ya Pitufaron Al Cachorro
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan absortos con el nuevo juguete de Pitufo Carpintero que se olvidan de dar de comer a Puppy. Gargamel atrae a Puppy hacia una jaula con comida y le mantiene cautivo para pedir un rescate: los secretos mágicos de los Pitufos. Los Pitufitos distraen a Gargamel con el juguete durante el tiempo necesario para rescatar a Puppy, y prometen no volver a dejarlo desatendido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las preocupaciones de Papá Pitufo hacen que le salgan verrugas. La única forma de librarle de esta enfermedad causada por la indecisión es que frote el cuerno de uno de los Verrugosos, los desaliñados, viscosos, estúpidos y brutales enemigos de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Choza No Es Un Hogar
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: El Libro De Bromas De Bromista
programme.desc: Las cajas sorpresa de Pitufo Bromista ya no resultan divertidas para los demás Pitufos. Pitufo Bromista busca nuevas ideas en su «Gran libro de las bromas», pero esas ideas son aún peor recibidas en la aldea. Y entonces, Gargamel llega con algunas bromas de su propia cosecha….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel inventa la leyenda del Pitufo Hechicero para engañar a Papá Pitufo y sus amigos Pitufos y conducirlos hacia una trampa en lo alto de la montaña. Papá Pitufo, con su ingenio, engaña al mago con algo de sus propia magia y Gargamel es perseguido montaña abajo y devuelto de nuevo a su castillo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un terrible gigante ayuda a Gargamel a capturar a los Pitufos para hacer una rica sopa, pero tendrá que enfrentar a Papá Pitufo primero.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos….

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo….

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La nota que Papá Pitufo escribió avisando a los demás Pitufos para que vean un cometa está rota. Al ser sólo capaces de leer una parte, los Pitufos creen que es el fin del mundo. Todos planean cómo será su último día, hasta que papá Pitufo regresa y clarifica el lío.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada vez que Pitufo Perezoso se queda dormido, tiene la misma pesadilla una y otra vez: se encuentra en poder de Morfeo, un malvado hechicero que quiere capturar a tantas almas dormidas como sea posible. Uno tras otro, todos los Pitufos van cayendo en las garras de Morfeo. ¿Todos? Quizá no, si Papá Pitufo puede evitarlo. Para ello, Papá Pitufo acude al Arenero en busca de ayuda….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango….

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La nueva obra de Pitufo Poeta va a ser su mayor creación de todos los tiempos, y contará con Pitufina, la preferida de todos, como actriz principal. Los demás Pitufos compiten por el honor de actuar junto a Pitufina. Incluso Pitufo Tímido, que es muy discreto y retraído, es uno de los candidatos al papel. Pero Pitufo Filósofo, que se ha autodesignado director de la obra, no lo ve de la misma manera….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: ¡alarma, Pitufos!
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos se sienten poco queridos y deciden huir. Se llevan consigo objetos que les recuerden su hogar, lo que hace que los Pitufos crean que hay un ladrón entre ellos. Pitufo Filósofo intenta atrapar al ladrón instalando pitufialarmas. Las alarmas provocan un estruendo que atrae a los Pitufitos de vuelta a casa, donde Papá Pitufo les convence de que los quieren.

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un terrible gigante ayuda a Gargamel a capturar a los Pitufos para hacer una rica sopa, pero tendrá que enfrentar a Papá Pitufo primero.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: El Pitufo Osado
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel tiene un plan infalible. Sin hacer caso de la risa burlona de Azrael, el malvado hechicero ha perfeccionado una sustancia mágica a la que ha llamado «polvo temerario», que convertirá a todos los Pitufos en temerarios e intrépidos aventureros. ¿Caerá Papá Pitufo en la trampa de Gargamel? ¿Atrapará su enemigo a todos los Pitufos? ¿Tendrá esta historia un final feliz?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La encantadora Allura posee una esfera mágica muy especial cuya energía, según ella misma dice, puede levantar el ánimo e inspirar a aquellos faltos de inspiración. Todo lo que hay que hacer es sostener la esfera con las manos… Es cierto que la esfera fomenta la inspiración, pero solo hasta cierto punto. Sin embargo, sus efectos secundarios pueden ser muy peligrosos, tal como descubren los Pitufos cuando se hacen adictos a la esfera….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, Listrado e AJ estão passando pela floresta quando Listrado encontra um pequeno besouro de fogo perdido chamado Fagulha. Blaze e seus amigos iniciam uma jornada pela floresta para ajudar Fagulha a voltar para casa.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Há um incêndio na ponte e ele é grande demais para o Comandante e sua equipe de bombeiros apagarem sozinhos. Eles precisam do bombeiro Blaze para ajudar. Com o tempo correndo, o Blaze se apressa para atravessar a cidade.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.sub-title: O Grand Prix da Cidade do Eixo
programme.desc: Blaze está pronto para uma corrida memorável na Cidade do Eixo com a ajuda da Gabby e o poderoso controle remoto dela que controla máquinas.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ e Gabby estão correndo em uma praia quando de repente avistam um navio pirata! Eles conhecem o Roda de Pau, um pirata que tem um antigo mapa do tesouro que vai levá-los até o tesouro mais incrível da ilha.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: A vovó do Esmagador está na cidade para assisti-lo em uma corrida na Cúpula Monster. Mas as coisas saem de controle quando o Esmagador tenta trapacear usando um esqui foguete.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ e vários espectadores se juntam para assistir aos dinossauros marcharem pela Cidade do Eixo! Mas Esmagador se intromete no desfile espalhando os dinossauros por toda parte.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Esmagador constrói um super aspirador de pó para limpar a bagunça que ele fez, mas a máquina sai do controle e acaba aspirando o próprio Esmagador e tudo o que vê pela frente!

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.sub-title: O superastro dos carros de corrida
programme.desc: Nos unimos a Blaze e a AJ enquanto eles planam através das nuvens, voando dentro de um incrível novo amigo, o Swoops, que os leva até a Velocidadelândia.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.sub-title: Corrida até a pedra da Águia
programme.desc: Blaze leva todos seus amigos Monster Machines à Velocidadelândia, onde eles participam de uma emocionante corrida até o topo da pedra da águia.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines: A corrida de cem milhas
programme.desc: O Blaze visita a "Velocidadelândia" com seus novos amigos carros de corrida na mais longa corrida de todas: a corrida de cem milhas! Mas o Esmagador está competindo também e ele fará de tudo para ganhar.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines: A Corrida Polar
programme.desc: O Blaze e amigos vão para"Velocidadelândia" e se transformam em carros para a Corrida Polar, uma corrida de inverno através da neve! Mas quando o carro de corrida Esmagador os tira da pista, os amigos precisam ficar para se manterem na corrida

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Zeg tem um ingresso para uma nova montanha russa dinossauro: a Montanha Dino! Mas quando o ingresso é soprado para longe, cabe ao Blaze ajudar seu amigo a encontrar o ingresso para eles voltarem ao parque de diversões.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: No Reino dos Carros Cavaleiros, o Blaze descobre uma máquina que seus amigos medievais usam para se recarregarem. Mas quando um dragão apanha a estação de carga, o Blaze lidera a busca para recuperar a máquina.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Gasquatch voltou! Ele estava guardando dinheiro para comprar o melhor brinquedo: um Robô Mega Lama! Mas quando ele perde as moedas dele, cabe ao Blaze ajudar seu amigo amante da lama a recuperá-las antes que a loja de brinquedos feche.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Uma ladra de luz está a solta deixando toda a cidade do eixo no escuro! Mas a Gabby equipa o Blaze com luzes especiais para ajudá-lo a encontrar a ladra de luz e recuperar as luzes roubadas.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.sub-title: Crianças, Família, Animação, Diversão, Brincadeira, Carros, Brinquedos, Pista, Corrida, Touro
programme.desc: O Blaze e a Starla descobrem um mapa que leva até a lendária Pista de Corrida do Touro Mecânico! Os amigos partem em uma busca no Oeste Selvagem para encontrarem a pista e fazerem a corrida da vida deles.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Blaze se transforma em um carro de reboque. E com a ajuda do AJ e da Gabby, ele sai em uma aventura totalmente incrível para salvar o Listrado

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: É o aniversário do Darington! O Esmagador usa um robô prato para tentar roubar o bolo de aniversário, mas o plano dele dá errado e o bolo sai voado. Será que o Blaze pegará o bolo fujão antes do Esmagador e salvará a festa?

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Blaze o AJ e o Listrado navegam até a Ilha dos Animais. Mas quando um lagarto ganancioso coloca a ilha em perigo, o Blaze e o Listrado precisam encontrar o lado selvagem deles para salvar seus amigos animais.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Blaze, a Starla e o Darington mal podem esperar para jogar o esporte favorito de todos os animais: o florestoból! Mas quando a integrante do Time Tucs, a tucano, sai voado do estádio, cabe aos amigos dela trazê-la de volta ao jogo.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Blaze e o Zeg estão na Ilha dos Animais quando eles descobrem um mundo de pequenas criaturas bem embaixo das rodas deles: A Cidade dos Insetos!

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: No céu acima da Ilha dos Animais, uma corrida memorável está para acontecer. Mas antes que o Blaze possa se juntar à corrida, ele precisa abrir as asas dele!

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.sub-title: Crianças, Família, Animação, Diversão, Brincadeira, Carros, Brinquedos, Felinos, Selvagens
programme.desc: O Blaze e o Listrado se transformam em ferozes e rápidos felinos selvagens para competirem no Campeonato da Ilha dos Animais! Mas para ganharem, eles terão que vencer o Esmagador disfarçado de leopardo.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Quando a Grande Coroa Animal é perdida no fundo do oceano, O Blaze se transforma em um tubarão super rápido para recuperá-la para os seus amigos da Ilha dos Animais. Mas ele terá que nadar rápido, ou o Esmagador pode chegar na coroa primeiro.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ e Gabby encontram uma nova Monster Machine chamada Watts, um carro muito rápido com pneus elétricos! Mas, quando um de seus pneus especiais sai rolando floresta adentro, Blaze, AJ e Gabby prometem recuperá-lo.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze e o pirata Roda de Pau se unem para uma grande caça ao tesouro! Juntos, eles têm que encontrar três chaves para abrir um baú especial. Mas o Esmagador também está navegando em alto-mar, e ele vai fazer de tudo para chegar ao tesouro primeiro!

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Quando o Esmagador tenta pegar a Supervelocidade só para ele, ele acidentalmente faz o motor de Blaze sair voando! Agora, Blaze e o Esmagador vão ver quem consegue pegar o Motor de Supervelocidade primeiro.

programme.desc: Uma brincadeira desencadeia uma briga que coloca em risco a continuidade de um dos casais.

programme.desc: Os médicos lutam para salvar um jovem levado à emergência congelado em sem pulso. Um homem fica fatalmente doente na sua festa de aniversário. Um segredo vergonhoso impede que um paciente corra para a sala de cirurgia para ser operado.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um médico precisa tomar uma difícil decisão se reanima ou não um paciente idoso com uma parada cardiorrespiratória. Duas enfermeiras encontram uma vítima de esfaqueamento na rua. Uma médica em um cruzeiro descobre que a sua viagem se tornou um pesadelo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem tem um choque anafilático. Um cara forte tem medo de agulha. Um homem se esfaqueia com uma espada ninja. Um paciente precisa de exorcismo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um paciente psiquiátrico tem uma paixão extrema por pudim de chocolate. Um paciente em choque anafilático pode ser alérgico à sua namorada. Um homem que está com o rosto bizarramente inchado precisa ser convencido a se tratar.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Na véspera de Natal, um homem vestido de Papai Noel está à beira da morte e a sua esposa pede um favor especial ao médico: coletar o sêmen de seu marido. Um homem não consegue respirar porque um peixe vivo está preso em sua garganta.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um garoto de seis anos sofre um derrame que ameaça a sua vida. Um homem está com um fogão de acampamento preso em seu pênis. Um jovem médico da emergência fica preocupado quando lhe pedem para verificar a saúde da esposa de outro médico.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: A Dra. Alexandra Dresel é testada quando uma vítima de assalto chega à emergência com duas balas no cérebro. O Dr. Mauricio Heilbron Jr. precisa testar seu autocontrole quando recebe dois casos complicados.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quando um bebê aparentemente saudável desenvolve repentinamente deficiência de oxigênio, a Dra. Beth Schissel encara um mistério médico. Quando a polícia leva ao hospital um homem desarrumado, a Dra. Kivela acha que há algum segredo sobre ele.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O Ecstasy e a Agonia. Doido Nu Esfaqueia Vítima. Salvando Duas Trompas. Árvore no Pescoço.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quem Mexe Com cobra é Picado. Entrega no Estacionamento. Explosão de HIV. O Homem de 270 quilos. O Bolo da Mãe Que Está Morrendo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher fica mais de 18 horas presa em um vaso sanitário. Os médicos se esforçam para salvar a vida de um homem mutilado por um triturador. Quando uma enfermeira desmaia no hospital, os médicos e membros da equipe fazem uma descoberta chocante.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Médicos fazem uma incisão peitoral enquanto aguardam o cirurgião. Uma iguana chega ao hospital com um paciente de um acidente de carro.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold, de 13 anos, é convocado para o serviço militar, a reação exagerada do Sr. Drummond ao erro óbvio, transforma os sonhos de Arnold em pesadelos.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Drummond recebe proteção policial de um tipo incomum depois que suas atividades filantrópicas levam a uma ameaça de extorsão de um milhão de dólares contra ele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: iCarly: Perdi minha cabeça em Las Vegas
programme.sub-title: Perdi minha cabeça em Las Vegas
programme.desc: Quando Sam descobre que sua mãe está em uma prisão em Las Vegas, Carly e Freddie decidem ajuda-la, reunindo seus pertences mais valiosos para vender e conseguir o dinheiro necessário para libertar a mãe de Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: O resgate de Carly
programme.desc: Sam se reencontra com Dana, uma velha amiga que foi recentemente liberada do centro de delinquentes juvenis. Sam avisa a todos para ficarem longe de Dana, mas Carly não a escuta e termina em sérios problemas.

programme.title: iCarly: Chocando o mundo Parte 1
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie decidem dedicar um programa ao humorista e apresentador de televisão Jimmy Fallon, depois que ele menciona iCarly em seu show. Impressionado pelo gesto, Jimmy convida os três amigos para irem a Nova York.

programme.title: iCarly: Chocando o mundo Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie decidem dedicar um programa ao humorista e apresentador de televisão Jimmy Fallon, depois que ele menciona iCarly em seu show. Impressionado pelo gesto, Jimmy convida os três amigos para irem a Nova York.

programme.title: iCarly: Pega ladrão!
programme.desc: Sam descobre que seu computador portátil desapareceu e dá a Freddie o número de série do equipamento para que ele possa localizar a câmera do computador e a ativar.

programme.title: iCarly: O adeus Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly está se conformando em não ir ao baile anual quando, de repente, seu pai aparece para acompanha-la. Além disso, sua noite tem mais uma surpresa quando seu pai a faz uma pergunta que mudará sua vida para sempre.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Quando Ms. Briggs reprova todos os participantes favoritos de Sam e Carly no show de talentos da escola, as duas garotas decidem criar uma página na internet e fazer um show semanal para mostrar o que elas quiserem.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly está apaixonada por um garoto de sua escola chamado Jake. Quando ela descobre que o garoto terminou seu namoro, ela aproveita a oportunidade para conquista-lo.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly e Sam competem com Freddie e Spencer para ver quem consegue chamar mais gente para ver o programa. Mas, quando as coisas não saem conforme o planejado, tudo vira uma grande confusão.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie querem que seu show seja comentado no Nevelocity, um popular site da internet que avalia programas e determina diretamente a sua popularidade entre os jovens.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: O avô de Spencer acha que ele é muito irresponsável e louco para ser o responsável de Carly. Agora, ela e seus amigos precisam provar ao vovô que ele é, sim, capaz de cumprir essa tarefa.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie tentam quebrar o recorde mundial pelo mais longo e contínuo programa. Para isso, iCarly terá de ficar no ar por mais de 24 horas seguidas!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Valerie, uma fã do iCarly, chama Freddie para um encontro. Eles se dão tão bem que Freddie começa a gravar o programa de Valerie.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly convida o ídolo das artes de Spencer, Harry Joyner, para conhecer o trabalho de seu irmão. Mas, quando Harry comenta que o trabalho de Spancer é amador, o garoto sente que sua vida já não tem nenhum propósito.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Mandy, a maior fã do iCarly, é convidada para assistir sozinha à gravação no estúdio. Mas Mandy se mostra tão inconveniente, que eles têm de se livrar dela.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly e Sam decidem cuidar de ovos para um projeto de ciências. O problema é que os pintinhos nascem antes do esperado e acabam fugindo da incubadora. Agora, as duas amigas precisam encontrar os pintinhos perdidos.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly dá a Sam uma camiseta única e exclusiva de iCarly para comemorar a amizade entre elas. Mas, quando Sam vende a peça para comprar ingressos, as duas melhores amigas acabam brigando.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly pede aos fãs que mandem vídeos de suas danças mais legais. Mas, quando mais de mil clipes chegam, Carly, Sam e Freddie lutam para assistir a todos eles.

programme.title: iCarly: O Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie fazem o iCarly em um apartamento "assombrado". Entretanto, coisas estranhas começam a acontecer e os amigos se apavoram: a fama do local deve ser real!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer salva a vida do vocalista da banda Plain White Ts e o convence a ir ao iCarly. Entretanto, coisas estranhas acontecem e tudo dá errado na hora da transmissão.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Sam é detida exatamente na noite do show especial de iCarly número 50. Impossibilitados de transmitirem o programa, Carly e Freddie fazem de tudo para serem presos também.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly está muito emocionada quando uma empresa famosa de sapatos chamada Daka entra em contato com ela para promover seus calçados no programa. O problema é que os sapatos são horrorosos!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly tira uma nota B em uma prova de História, mas está convencida de que merecia um A. Sam encontra a oportunidade perfeita durante uma reunião semanal com o Diretor Franklin e muda a nota de Carly no computador.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Uma grande produtora quer transformar iCarly num programa de televisão. Mas Carly, Sam e Freddie logo se irritam com todas as exigências necessárias.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: O namoro de Sam está atrapalhando as gravações do programa on-line de Carly, por isso, Carly e Freddie vão fazer de tudo para separá-los.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Fim da Batalha! A Orgulhosa Fantasia Ecoa Ao Longe!
programme.desc: Após a batalha épica contra Enel, o sol volta a brilhar sobre a Ilha do Céu e seus cidadãos reconstroem seu lar.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eu Estive Aqui! O Fio Tecido Pelo Poneglifo!
programme.desc: Robin tenta decifrar o enigma de um misterioso poneglifo. Usopp negocia com os locais e Luffy ataca os tesouros inimagináveis da lendária cidade do ouro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: De Volta ao Mar Azul! Despedida Trançada em Sentimentos!
programme.desc: Com uma ajudinha de seus novos amigos, os Chapéus de Palha dizem adeus a Skypiea e seguem novamente para o Mar Azul.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Estado de Emergência! Infiltrados por um Infame Navio Pirata!
programme.desc: A Marinha está convencida de que o Merry é um navio fantasma depois que a embarcação dos Chapéus de Palha cai no forte vinda dos céus. Seus tripulantes, porém, desaparecem.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sanji, o Cozinheiro! Prove Seu Mérito no Refeitório!
programme.desc: Disfarçado, Sanji mostra aos chefs da Marinha, liderados por Jessica, como é que se cozinha uma refeição decente para os soldados famintos.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Zoro Capturado e as Operações de Emergência de Chopper!
programme.desc: Zoro acaba prisioneiro na fortaleza, e Chopper e Nami auxiliam uma nervosa médica que trata dos soldados feridos em combate.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Cerco da Marinha se Fecha! O Segundo Pirata é Capturado!
programme.desc: Robin e Usopp se disfarçam do mesmo inspetor externo da Marinha, e Luffy e Sanji são descobertos por Jonathan.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Os Audaciosos Luffy e Sanji! A Grande Operação de Resgate!
programme.desc: O verdadeiro Shepherd é jogado na cela de Zoro e Usopp, e Luffy e Sanji correm para resgatar seus companheiros antes que sejam também capturados.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Sangue Quente das Forças Especiais! Batalha na Ponte!
programme.desc: Luffy e Sanji, após libertarem Zoro e Usopp, tentam fugir de Navarone. A unidade de elite da Marinha é acionada, e Nami e Chopper chegam às docas.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Quebrando o Cerco! O Going Merry é Recuperado!
programme.desc: O bando se encontra nas docas e acaba cercado pela Marinha. Usando Nami como falsa refém, eles conseguem fazer os inimigos os deixarem subir a bordo do Merry novamente.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Navio Pirata Desaparece! O Segundo Round da Batalha no Forte!
programme.desc: O bando disfarça o Merry de navio da Marinha para que consigam recuperar seu tesouro. Com o ouro, eles decidem que vão contratar um construtor naval.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: As Operações de Recuperação do Ouro e do Waver!
programme.desc: Usopp separa o bando em dois: a equipe de recuperação do ouro e a de recuperação do waver. Shepherd decide capturar Luffy por conta própria.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Investida Total! A Tática Secreta de Fogo Certeiro de Jonathan!
programme.desc: Zoro, Usopp, Sanji e Robin continuam a busca pelo tesouro, e Luffy leva Nami aos aposentos do capitão para recuperar o ouro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Adeus, Forte da Marinha! A Última Batalha Pela Fuga!
programme.desc: O Merry acaba encalhado na maré baixa e Jonathan acredita ter conseguido seu xeque-mate. O Discador de Impacto impulsiona o navio, e os Discadores de Sopro e de Chamas inflam o balão polvo novamente, para a fuga.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Grande Aventura em Long Ring Long Land!
programme.desc: Luffy e seus companheiros sobrevivem a um encontro quase mortal com monstros marítimos, mas acabam em uma misteriosa ilha onde tudo é muito mais comprido do que deveria ser!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Davy Back com os Piratas Foxy!
programme.desc: Luffy acaba envolvido em uma Davy Back Fight com os Piratas de Foxy. O Chapéu de Palha nunca foge de um desafio, mas nesta disputa pode perder seus companheiros!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Primeira Partida! Uma Volta na Donut Race!
programme.desc: A Davy Back começa com uma Donut Race ao redor de Long Ring Long Land! O bando enfrenta Foxy para decidir quem perderá um membro da tripulação!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Foxy Raposa de Prata! A Interferência Impiedosa!
programme.desc: Nami usa suas habilidades de navegação para colocar o bando à beira da vitória, mas Foxy tem mais do que alguns meros truques sujos na manga!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Segunda Partida! Pra Cima Deles no Groggy Ring!
programme.desc: Graças a uma trapaça de Foxy, Chopper acaba perdido para o inimigo. A única esperança de recuperá-lo jaz em Zoro e Sanji, mas eles precisarão aprender a trabalhar juntos para salvar a pobre rena!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Uma Enxurrada de Cartões Vermelhos no Groggy Ring!
programme.desc: Sanji e Zoro apanham, mas não desistem. Com uma pitada de sorte - e um pouco de trabalho em equipe - eles saem vitoriosos do segundo round da Davy Back Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Terceira Partida! A Roller Race Oval!
programme.desc: O Round 3 da Davy Back Fight é uma corrida num circuito oval! O destino de Chopper está por um triz, e o bando tem um problema: Luffy não sabe andar de patins!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Corrida em Temperatura Máxima! Rumo à Última Disputa!
programme.desc: Nas voltas finais da última disputa da Davy Back Fight, Luffy e os Chapéus de Palha precisam vencer para recuperar Chopper dos Piratas Foxy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Na segunda Davy Back Fight, a primeira partida é um jogo de queimada entre os Chapéus de Palha de Luffy e os Piratas Foxy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Duelo no Monte! Sinal Verde, Sinal Vermelho!
programme.desc: Na sequência da segunda Davy Back Fight, Nami, Usopp, Chopper, Sanji e Zoro precisam disputar o Dodge Touch Daruma, uma brincadeira de Sinal Verde, Sinal Vermelho entre piratas!
